Frame — local speech recognition

Transformers.js 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0): huggingface-transformers-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js/tree/3.8.1
Jinja template utilities: huggingface-jinja-LICENSE.txt

ONNX Runtime Node 1.21.0 and Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4 (MIT): onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/v1.21.0
https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/tree/89f8206ba4
Native distributions include CPU runtime binaries for their target OS/architecture.
CUDA libraries are not needed. Sharp/libvips is excluded from the audio-only speech bundle.

Whisper Tiny (MIT): whisper-LICENSE.txt
https://github.com/openai/whisper
Model source: https://huggingface.co/openai/whisper-tiny
Quantized ONNX conversion:
https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-tiny/tree/ff4177021cc41f7db950912b73ea4fdf7d01d8e7
Model files are vendored in the repository with SHA-256 integrity checks and bundled in desktop packages. Web serves these verified files with the application. Runtime model downloads from Hugging Face are disabled.
Media is processed locally; no audio is sent to the model provider.
